items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And I’ve had Hank Jones play for me.” And I said to myself, why is she saying that?

ctx.x: They are sure at your mercy, that’s right. And you’re not. And I think it makes a big difference.

Remember that one that had the attitude in Buffalo? Came on and decided, “Well I’m not used to having a woman piano player. And I’ve had Hank Jones play for me.” And I said to myself, why is she saying that? So she put her music up there, and so then she started singing “My Funny Valentine.” And so every time she said [sings] “my funny valentine” I moved up a half step. “Sweet funny valentine” another half step. “You made me smile when you’re”— I said now that’ll teach her. And so after that, she had much respect.
